2180752.synopsis:
Magic is alive and well in the world, inside beings known as Majiks. By completing a Majik’s trial, a Witch can gain its power. However, only women can become Witches or use magical items. All that changes one day when a young man named Ichi turns the world on its head by defeating an infamous Majik and gaining its magical powers!



(Source: VIZ Media)



Notes:

- Winner of the 2025 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.

- Ranked 11th in Da Vinci's 2025 Book of the Year ranking.

- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.

- Ranked 10th in the 19th Manga Taisho in 2026.

- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2026.
